sealed_window.alignment_policy: Use a ratio observation only when the sealed VIX and VIX3M sources both contain the same Cboe date. Do not fill, interpolate or substitute the nineteen VIX-only dates.

publication_timing_boundary: Use a matched Cboe VIX and VIX3M business-day close only at 00:00 UTC on the following calendar day or later. Persist the latest matched state across weekends, holidays and VIX-only dates. Never use same-UTC-day BTC bars before that boundary.
revision_boundary: The create-only raw download and its frozen 2018-2024 window are the sole VIX3M input for this experiment. A later Cboe download cannot replace, repair or extend it after BTC outcome access.
claim_boundary: Cboe identifies VIX3M as a three-month expected-volatility index. Source identity and timing do not prove that the VIX/VIX3M ratio predicts BTC returns or improves a BTC-or-cash policy.
scope_note: Free public historical data only; no paid API, account, key, BTC outcome access during capture, forward import, canonical state write or Trading action was used.
